_doc: Shipped event calendar (spec §3.4): FOMC decision dates published by the Federal Reserve; refresh yearly. CME expiry needs no table (deterministic last-Friday rule in data/context_engine.py). Halvings live in code constants + config estimate. 2026 dates VERIFIED against https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm on 2026-07-24 (decision = second day of each 2-day meeting); all 8 matched the brief's dates exactly, no corrections needed.
